panel_mcp.title: MCP Toolset
panel_mcp.desc: Manage MCP server endpoints (STDIO process or Streamable HTTP with SSE fallback), choose which tools are exposed to the model, and whether resources are injected into the context.

panel_mcp.http_mode_auto: Auto (Streamable HTTP, fall back to SSE)
panel_mcp.http_mode_hint: Auto-detect tries Streamable HTTP first and falls back to the 2024-11-05 HTTP+SSE transport when the server does not support it.
panel_mcp.log_level_hint: Controls how much this endpoint writes to the debug panel and whether STDIO server stderr is forwarded.
panel_mcp.protocol_mode_hint: The handshake version is recommended: it skips the new-protocol probe, avoiding the probe timeout and the 'client initialization error' it logs. Switch to auto or 2026-07-28 only when the server supports nothing else.

panel_mcp.resource_injection_hint: Checked resources are read and written into a system fragment when the pre-generation node runs.
